'''2007 Worlds Day 3 Mike Honsho DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Honsho]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet names Brian/Fred/Mike crossed → Honsho. Deck title Why the long face? Line 60 Much Anger struck (duplicate of line 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Honsho]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out From The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
